metadata.description: Go-to-market skills for Claude Code from the Unleash community.

plugins.name: unleash-venture-skills
plugins.description: Battle-tested go-to-market skills: asset foundations, landing pages, drip campaigns, prospect lists, cold outbound, LinkedIn, sales scripts, content, SEO strategy, Meta ads, investor one-pagers and a slop checker.

plugins.name: asset-foundation-builder
plugins.description: Builds the customer-truth foundation every other GTM asset draws on: a Kennedy 13-row CSV plus a niche-brief MD researched from YouTube, web, Reddit, forums, podcasts and call transcripts (pains, false beliefs, market size, jargon to use and avoid, recognition quotes, where the audience gathers, hooks).

plugins.name: content-engine
plugins.description: Framework-driven content production with voice training, target-group research and platform optimisation.

plugins.name: facebook-ads-from-customer-transcripts
plugins.description: Turns customer interview transcripts into a battery of Facebook / Meta ad variants (hooks, bodies, CTAs) in the customer's own language.

plugins.name: how-to-run-a-company-brain
plugins.description: Interviews you about your business, then hands you a ready-to-run build file that scaffolds a complete company brain: a folder-based memory Claude draws every answer from, so it stops guessing and remembers your context across chat, Cowork and Code.

plugins.name: inbound-marketing-playbook
plugins.description: Builds a landing page and its drip campaign together as one sequenced, aligned inbound funnel.

plugins.name: landing-page-builder
plugins.description: Builds a high-converting two-page landing page plus progressive signup flow for a specific niche, with scene-first headlines, proof-only claims and pre-publish checks.

plugins.name: linkedin-outreach
plugins.description: Runs a systematic LinkedIn connection and DM pipeline with safety limits.

plugins.name: outbound-copy-manager
plugins.description: Writes a 3-email cold outbound sequence with 5 opener variants for A/B testing.

plugins.name: outreach-draft-writer
plugins.description: Drafts content-first LinkedIn and email outreach using an engagement-before-outreach playbook, with a Cialdini principle mapped to each message.

plugins.name: prospect-list-builder
plugins.description: Systematic prospect identification, enrichment and scoring (Sales Navigator, Dream 100, multi-source export).

plugins.name: sales-script-creator
plugins.description: Builds a niche-specific discovery and closing sales framework in English or German from your customer interview transcripts, based on Belfort (Straight Line + Looping), Hormozi (Value Equation) and Kagan (validation-first).

plugins.name: seo-strategy-builder
plugins.description: Crawls your website with a real browser, researches live search results for your niche, and returns a prioritised list of new pages to create — each with a target keyword, a demand estimate backed by evidence, and the reason you can rank.

plugins.name: unleash-stop-slop
plugins.description: Strips the AI tells out of any draft before it goes out.

plugins.name: venture-one-pager-builder
plugins.description: Audits a completed venture assessment against what an angel or advisor needs to see, reports what's missing, then builds a branded one-page PDF in your own CI plus the intro blurb that carries it.
